title: CURRENT_STATE.md's frontend section still documents a Next.js SSR/prerender architecture the app no longer has
repro: Read docs/CURRENT_STATE.md sec3.8 as a new contributor (it is explicitly billed in the doc's own reference list as 'read first to learn what exists') -> it describes 'Next.js 16 App Router static export' and 'SSR safety... since the dockview layout library is not SSR-safe' -> open package.json and index.html -> the app is a Vite 8 + React 19 client-side SPA with zero Next.js dependency; there is no SSR, no prerender pass, and no App Router at all.
evidence: docs/CURRENT_STATE.md:544-546 (still asserts 'Next.js 16 App Router static export (output:"export")... SSR-safety rests on one invariant'); package.json:7-9 (scripts.dev='vite', scripts.build='vite build', no 'next' dependency anywhere in the file); index.html:1-11 (plain Vite SPA shell, <script type="module" src="/src/main.tsx">); git log --oneline -- vite.config.ts (commit 8c2f9ab 'feat(shell): migrate Next.js -> Vite 8 + React 19 (WS1)', already an ancestor of HEAD 38919fd); docs/redesign/DECISIONS.md D6 ('Vite migration verdict: zero blockers... tauri.conf.json devUrl/beforeDevCommand edits are required by the WS1 mandate'); src/components/PanelHost.tsx:118-119 (docstring still reads 'which keeps the static-export build SSR-safe (the prerender pass sees the loading state)' -- a stale comment for a build mode that no longer exists)
notes: The migration itself (commit 8c2f9ab, decision D6) is sound and deliberate -- this is a pure doc-accuracy defect, not a functional regression. grep -i vite docs/CURRENT_STATE.md returns zero hits: the file has never been updated for the stack change, so its own 'honest current-state inventory... read first' billing is false for the entire sec3.8 frontend-shell section (Next.js/App Router/SSR framing, static-export claim). A stale in-code comment (PanelHost.tsx:118-119) compounds this by describing SSR-prerender safety for a component that no longer runs under SSR at all -- a future maintainer reading only the code could reasonably (and wrongly) conclude removing the loading-placeholder gate is SSR-safe to do, when its real remaining purpose is now just async-module-registration timing in a CSR app. Smallest fix: rewrite CURRENT_STATE.md sec3.8's opening paragraph for Vite/CSR reality and correct the PanelHost.tsx docstring to state the CSR-timing reason instead of the retired SSR reason.
